facts.fact: The government press office reports that a four-day working week opened in Malabo on 2 September 2026 with eight World Bank Group specialists, with the aim of completing and validating the Estrategia Nacional de Economía Digital.
The article describes the Estrategia Nacional de Economía Digital as still to be completed and validated and cites no published text or period.

On 2 September 2026 the Ministry of Transport, Telecommunications and Civil Aviation, led by Minister of State Honorato Evita Oma, opened the World Bank-supported working week to finish the strategy, expecting a consensus roadmap at its close.
